limitations: Statistically reconstructed, not direct transient GCM output.

monthly_mean_near_surface_temperature_ta.endpoint_candidate_derivation: monthly tas, arithmetic annual mean, convert K to Celsius; do not substitute tasmin/tasmax

limitations: Independent model chain and much finer nominal grid do not constitute independent observations or permission to upscale ARCANA support.
Precipitation includes both liquid and solid phases.
Temperature has model mean tas plus tasmin/tasmax; only tas is semantically eligible for P7S mean-temperature predictor.
Output is COG according to CHELSA catalogue; selective range/window access and actual bytes per selected tile remain unverified.
Do not resample the 30-arcsec product onto finer ARCANA support; retain native provider support/provenance.
CHELSA_TRACE21K.license: CHELSA catalogue reports CC0 for the dataset; EnviDat record/paper reports differing CC BY terms; confirm governing data-package license before use

p7s_predictor_binding.temperature: Use monthly mean air temperature; compute arithmetic mean of the 12 monthly climatology values, then K-to-C conversion where required. P7S endpoint local payload comparison confirmed monthly mean temperature reproduces annual_temperature_c to float32 tolerance. Do not use tasmin/tasmax in place of tas.
p7s_predictor_binding.precipitation: P7S endpoint annual_precipitation_mm_yr equals sum of its 12 monthly_precipitation_mm values to float32 tolerance. Provider monthly unit/aggregation semantics must be reconciled before cross-product annual totals are compared.
p7s_predictor_binding.seasonality: Exact bound endpoint formula verified from the local D2D payload: population standard deviation of 12 monthly precipitation values (ddof=0) divided by their arithmetic mean; dimensionless, no x100. This ratio is invariant under a uniform positive unit conversion. Compute from monthly provider values, not BIO15 unless its scale/formula is independently matched.
p7s_predictor_binding.temperature_predictor_candidate: annual mean of monthly mean climatology, not tasmin/tasmax

endpoint_0ka_vs_arcana.compare_against: same 65 P7S proof cells and current bound ARCANA 0-ka monthly temperature/precipitation
